name: Camtono (Improved)
description: A camtono is a secured, handle container used for transporting valuable goods. A camtono comes with one key. Without the key, unlocking the camtono requires a DC 21 security kit to force open. It stores 7 lb., not exceeding 1/4 cubic foot, has an AC of 12, and 45 hit points. Destroying the camtono risks damaging any goods stored inside.
